# Real-source regression fixtures

`document-real.md` and `node-document-real.md` are excerpts from the local
Aspose.Words-API-References checkout under `english/net/aspose.words/document`
and `english/net/aspose.words/node/document`. The Document fixture omits the
large member tables, retaining front matter, declaration and Examples sections.
The Node.Document fixture retains the source page. These exercise identity
collisions and example boundaries independently of downloaded source checkouts.

`save-real.md` and `lines-real.md` retain the local source pages for
`aspose.words/document/save` and `aspose.words.properties/builtindocumentproperties/lines`.
They cover multiple declarations per page and example statements that must not
be mistaken for property signatures.
